summary: Reconcile ambiguous S3 publication and fence incomplete upload cleanup at the final manifest key. API impact: existing contract.

guide.reason: S3-compatible is an advertised destination. Reconciling an ambiguous publication is internal to Core; backup-now.md already describes the interrupted-publication outcome and the S3 troubleshooting covers provider conditional operations.

api.reason: An uncertain S3 final manifest write keeps the existing needs_attention result until exact publication or fenced abort settles; no route, schema, authentication or authorization change.

roadmap.reason: Corrects the current destination publication and recovery gate.

state.reason: The existing Core run/journal remain authoritative; new exact intent and abort records plus permanent final-key and artifact-key tombstones live in the S3 destination under the pool repository owner. A fresh Controller adopts settled or uncertain runs from authenticated Core inventory.
state.record: S3 repository .nex-intent-<operation>, .nex-abort-<operation> and permanent <operation>/manifest.json plus artifact-key abort tombstones
state.adoption: The pool master reads its retained run/catalog and repository records; Controller reads the master's authenticated inventory and operation results.

verification.method: Source review found terminal failure after a possible committed S3 manifest. Fake-S3 focused tests cover denied final write, interrupted cleanup, unknown or mutated objects, lost reply plus failed immediate read, delayed conditional final PUT and delayed single/multipart artifact writes released after abort. Independent P1 final-write and P2 artifact-orphan findings corrected the initial design; the final same-key tombstones and adversarial tests passed independent read-only review. Focused S3 and member predicate race tests passed. A matched disposable MinIO build ignored wrong-ETag conditional delete, so Core safely refused registration. A pinned single-process S3Proxy filesystem service passed Core registration, protected two-disk backup/restore and a fixture-only final-manifest 403 after full artifacts; same-ID Core restart terminal-failed with exact permanent abort tombstones, no point, stable replay and protected/source hashes. A separate committed final PUT with dropped reply and nine failed reads autonomously settled the same member run succeeded, one point and byte-identical objects without recapture. Broader provider proof and forge CI remain open.
verification.limits: Provider safety depends on atomic conditional PutObject at the final key and conditional DeleteObject; the available MinIO build failed Core registration because it deleted a wrong-ETag sentinel; a bounded S3Proxy single-process cleanup gate passed, but production multi-process/provider proof remains pending. S3 versioning may retain historical object versions after logical cleanup.
